## About
We're a family owned and operated shop on Greenwood Ave N in Seattle. Owner Tony runs this place as an alternative to impersonal and expensive service at dealerships.
When you bring your car in, our service advisor notes what you need. For most routine services we can give you a price estimate on the spot. If not, we diagnose the problem first and give you a quote once we know what the repair will take. One technician takes care of your car from start to finish.
We're rated 4.7 from 151 Google reviews. One reviewer called us 'a delightful neighborhood auto shop,' and we'd like to be yours too.

## Services
- Factory scheduled maintenance: Keep up with the maintenance schedule your car's maker recommends.
- Engine repairs: Diagnosis and repair when your engine isn't running right.
- Brakes service: Brake work done by one technician from start to finish.
- Cooling system service: Overheating issues and cooling system work. One reviewer said Tony found their car's radiator needed replacement.
- Buyer and safety inspection: A look at a car before you buy it, or a check on the one you have.
- Engine and body electrical repairs: Electrical problems in the engine or the body of the car.
- Steering and suspension services: Work on steering and suspension components.
- Transmission and clutch services: Transmission and clutch work for your import.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We're an Asian import vehicle service and repair shop, and we handle all of your automotive needs for those cars.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Come in for any service need, or schedule an appointment with us by phone or by email.

Q: Will I know the price before you start?
A: For most routine services we can give you a price estimate on the spot. Otherwise we diagnose the problem and give you a quote as soon as we know what's needed.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday during business hours and closed on weekends.

## What customers say
- "In short - Honest, sincere mechanic who isn’t just looking to make a profit, but who thinks just as much about what’s best for you and your car.

My 2007 Toyota Prius needs new struts and shocks. I started calling around for estimates - Tony’s estimate was about $1k less than other places I had called, so I decided to start saving up to go to him. In the meantime, while saving, my car had an unrelated mechanical problem and wasn’t starting while I was parked somewhere I couldn’t stay for long. I decided to call Tony and get his thoughts. He was very patient and helpful, despite not receiving any financial compensation for this very short phone call. He advised me to try a few things before seeing about having it towed to his shop. I called one other local mechanic, to get a second opinion. This second call was notably different - he was polite, but solely focused on getting the car towed to his shop as soon as possible. I really wasn’t looking forward to an unexpected tow bill. After a while, thankfully, the car started up and I was able to drive it home. Although it was just a few minutes on the phone, Tony’s selfless kindness left an impact on me that day.

A few days later, when I was thinking about next steps to getting this problem investigated and fixed, I called Tony again. I wanted to drive it to his shop for a brief inspection, before making the decision to tow it all the way down to Portland, where my car is still on warranty for some large repairs from last year. Instead, he advised me that a brief inspection would be pointless, and it was a better use of my time and money to just take it down to Portland right away. Another shop I called to ask for the same brief inspection here in Seattle before going to Portland was willing to do it. When I called them back and explained Tony’s reason for not scheduling me, they admitted that his reasoning was solid and the inspection was indeed unnecessary.

While I haven’t yet been to Tony’s shop, I can attest that in my brief interactions with him over the phone, he seems like a trustworthy man with good principles." (Erica Taicz-Blandón, 5/5)
- "Tony is wonderful and knows his stuff, was able to help me with a spark plug swap and answered all my questions about upcoming maintenance on my vehicle. Called in advance before using a special tool that would come with an extra charge, which was a nice change of pace from the surprise add-ons I'm used to dealing with. Still paid less than I was expecting to. I'm happy to have found such a delightful neighborhood auto shop, can't recommend enough." (dwax, 5/5)

The price seemed very reasonable, he allowed me to drop it off and pick it up a couple days later to work around my schedule and the car is running great again. Will definitely be back next time I encounter any car troubles. Thanks again Tony, much appreciated and happy holidays👌" (Adam Creary, 5/5)
